xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3115: Pipeline membership read door returns 503 for 6 of 12 registered projects — the authoritative resolver is blind for half the fleet

plan.title: Pipeline membership read door: typed per-project unavailability instead of 503
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: GET /api/pipeline/membership?project=<key> — the canonical read door flywheel Mission #3 must call for every registered project — returns 503 for 6 of 12 registered projects (verified on disk 2026-07-26: auricle's polyrepo 'infra' path is not a git repo; pan-tts is master-only while config says main; papers-please/puzzdom have no issue_prefix; lexerra/krux's GitHub App is not installed so the forge 404s). The snapshot layer discards the failure TYPE (lastError is a plain string), so the route can only emit a bare 503 with prose. An orchestrator cannot distinguish 'no pipeline work' from 'could not tell', so it either silently under-reports the pipeline or falls back to ad-hoc derivation — the drift the two-door model exists to prevent.
narratives.Proposal: Introduce a typed unavailability contract end to end. (1) Define MembershipUnavailableReason (missing_issue_prefix | repo_unavailable | default_branch_unresolved | forge_unavailable | tracker_unconfigured | gather_failed) plus PipelineMembershipUnavailableBody in @overdeck/contracts, and a PipelineMembershipUnavailableError in the gather module. (2) The gather throws typed errors: repo-path preflight fails closed naming the path; the default branch is resolved from repo reality (configured-if-verifiable → origin/HEAD → current HEAD → main/master probe); forge-lens failures rethrow as forge_unassigned by lens boundary, never by error-text parsing. (3) The snapshot/service propagates the reason. (4) The route returns HTTP 200 with the typed body for determined failures (success keeps the bare array; cold-boot loading keeps the PAN-2972 503). (5) /api/registered-projects gains additive membershipQueryable. (6) The frontend probe parses the typed body and preserves the error+Retry UX. (7) Docs and orchestrator prompts (PIPELINE-MEMBERSHIP.md, flywheel.md, uat-promote-notify, pipeline-status skill) teach the two response shapes.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No edits to ~/.overdeck/projects.yaml (phantom auricle infra entry, pan-tts default_branch, papers-please/puzzdom prefixes are operator registration decisions)
- No installing the GitHub App on eltmon/lexerra or eltmon/krux
- No change to getPipelineMembershipForProjects throw-on-first-error semantics (no production callers)
- No change to resource-discovery or the issues route (already degrade per project)
- No uniform response envelope for the success case (bare PipelineMembership[] array preserved)
- No partial-lens gathering for polyrepo projects with a missing member checkout (fail closed)
- No classifying failures by parsing gh/HTTP error message text (reasons come from lens boundaries)

autoDecisions.summary: Determined failures return HTTP 200 with {status:'unavailable', reason, message, projectKey}; success keeps the bare array (no uniform envelope)
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue mandates never 503-ing a determined failure; keeping the success array is no-loss for the frontend probe, the flywheel doc parsing, and the resource-strip Playwright mock, which all already handle non-array failure responses.

autoDecisions.summary: Cold-boot 'loading' (no snapshot, no recorded error) keeps the PAN-2972 fast-503 + Retry behavior
autoDecisions.rationale: It is a seconds-long transient that self-heals on the first background refresh, not a determined answer; a third 200-status would force a new frontend state for no operator value.

autoDecisions.summary: A non-repo project/polyrepo-member path fails the whole project closed with repo_unavailable naming the path
autoDecisions.rationale: Gathering a partial lens set (e.g. auricle without infra) could silently classify issues with only-missing-repo branches as clean_terminal — a wrong authoritative answer is worse than a loud typed blind spot.

autoDecisions.summary: Default branch resolved from repo reality rather than editing machine config
autoDecisions.rationale: Fixes pan-tts (master-only) and every future master-based project permanently; the configured default_branch stays the first preference when it verifies.

autoDecisions.summary: papers-please/puzzdom get no invented issue_prefix; the door reports missing_issue_prefix and registered-projects exposes membershipQueryable
autoDecisions.rationale: Their tracker identity is an operator registration decision that cannot be derived from code; the additive flag lets orchestrators skip them deliberately instead of discovering the failure.

autoDecisions.summary: Reasons are assigned by which lens failed, never by parsing error message text
autoDecisions.rationale: String-matching gh/HTTP error output is brittle across gh versions and locales; the lens boundary (tracker/forge vs git vs spec) is a stable classifier, with gather_failed as the honest fallback.

items.title: Add MembershipUnavailableReason + unavailable body to contracts and the typed error class

expected_outputs: gather test file passes including the new typed-error test

narrative.Action: In packages/contracts/src/types.ts add MEMBERSHIP_UNAVAILABLE_REASONS (const array: 'missing_issue_prefix', 'repo_unavailable', 'default_branch_unresolved', 'forge_unavailable', 'tracker_unconfigured', 'gather_failed'), the MembershipUnavailableReason union type derived from it, and PipelineMembershipUnavailableBody {status:'unavailable', reason, message, projectKey}. In src/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.ts add and export class PipelineMembershipUnavailableError extends Error carrying readonly reason: MembershipUnavailableReason. Rebuild contracts (cd packages/contracts && npm run build) before root typecheck. Add a unit test in tests/unit/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.test.ts asserting the error exposes .reason and that the union order matches the constant array.

items.title: Given the built contracts package, when a consumer imports MEMBERSHIP_UNAVAILABLE_REASONS, then it contains exactly the six documented reason strings and MembershipUnavailableReason type-checks against them
Given new PipelineMembershipUnavailableError('repo_unavailable', 'msg'), when reading .reason and .message, then they return 'repo_unavailable' and 'msg'
Given the contracts change, when running `cd packages/contracts && npm run build` then root `npm run typecheck`, then both complete without errors
Fail closed with repo_unavailable when a project or polyrepo-member path is not a git repo

narrative.Action: At the top of snapshotBranchRefs (src/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.ts:310-330), before the three existing git calls, run `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` via the injected run dep. On rejection OR when the realpath-normalized toplevel differs from the realpath-normalized repoPath (a subdir of an unrelated parent repo must not silently classify that repo's branches), throw PipelineMembershipUnavailableError('repo_unavailable', `Workspace repo path is not a git repository: ${repoPath}`). This single chokepoint covers both gatherProjectLensSignals and gatherIssueBranchContainment. Tests with fake run: (a) rejecting run → typed error, reason repo_unavailable, message contains the repo path; (b) toplevel '/other/repo' for repoPath '/expected/repo' → typed error; (c) matching toplevel → proceeds to the three existing calls.

items.title: Given a fake run that rejects with 'not a git repository', when snapshotBranchRefs is called, then it throws PipelineMembershipUnavailableError with reason 'repo_unavailable' and the message contains the repo path

Given a fake run returning a toplevel that differs from the configured repo path, when snapshotBranchRefs is called, then it throws reason 'repo_unavailable' instead of classifying the parent repo's branches
Given a fake run returning the matching toplevel, when snapshotBranchRefs is called, then it proceeds to issue the for-each-ref and rev-list calls and returns the parsed snapshot
Resolve each repo's effective default branch from repo reality

narrative.Action: Add exported resolveRepositoryDefaultBranch(repoPath, configured, run) to src/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.ts and call it in snapshotBranchRefs; the resolved name feeds both --no-merged= and `rev-list --first-parent` (currently line 327). Resolution order, each step via the injected run: (1) configured branch if `git rev-parse --verify --quiet refs/heads/<b>` succeeds; else refs/remotes/origin/<b> → use 'origin/<b>'; (2) `git symbolic-ref --quiet --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`; (3) `git symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD`; (4) probe 'main', 'master', 'origin/main', 'origin/master' in order; (5) else throw PipelineMembershipUnavailableError('default_branch_unresolved', ...) naming repoPath and the configured value. Tests with fake run keyed on argv: master-only repo (configured 'main' unverifiable, HEAD → master) → resolves 'master' and the rev-list call uses 'master'; configured branch verifiable → configured wins and no further probes run; repo with no refs at all → typed default_branch_unresolved.

items.title: Given a master-only fake repo whose configured default is 'main', when snapshotBranchRefs runs, then it resolves 'master' and issues `git rev-list --first-parent master`
Given a fake repo where refs/heads/main verifies, when resolving, then the result is 'main' and no symbolic-ref or probe calls are issued
Given a fake repo with no verifiable refs, when resolving, then it throws PipelineMembershipUnavailableError with reason 'default_branch_unresolved' naming the repo path and configured value
Type gather failures by lens boundary (forge_unavailable / tracker_unconfigured / missing_issue_prefix / gather_failed)

narrative.Action: In gatherProjectLensSignals (src/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.ts:395-546): convert the 'Missing issue_prefix' throw (line 400) to reason 'missing_issue_prefix' and the resolveProjectTrackerType 'Cannot resolve tracker' throw (line 191) to 'tracker_unconfigured'. Wrap each forge-lens promise — listTrackerIssues, listOpenIssues, listPhaseLabeledIssues, listOpenPullRequests, listIssueStates, listMergedPullRequestHeads — so a rejection that is NOT already a PipelineMembershipUnavailableError rethrows as PipelineMembershipUnavailableError('forge_unavailable', originalMessage); wrap the spec lens (listSpecIssueIds) rejections as 'gather_failed'. No error-message string matching anywhere. Tests with injected deps (the module already takes PipelineMembershipGatherDeps): listOpenIssues rejecting with Error('HTTP 404') → typed forge_unavailable, message preserved; listSpecIssueIds rejecting → gather_failed; a PipelineMembershipUnavailableError from the git preflight passes through unchanged (not re-wrapped).

items.title: Given listOpenIssues rejects with Error('HTTP 404'), when gatherProjectLensSignals runs, then it throws reason 'forge_unavailable' and the message contains 'HTTP 404'
Given a project with no issue_prefix, when gatherProjectLensSignals runs, then it throws reason 'missing_issue_prefix' naming the project
Given the git preflight throws PipelineMembershipUnavailableError('repo_unavailable'), when the forge wrapper sees it, then the reason stays 'repo_unavailable' (no re-wrap to forge_unavailable)
Given listSpecIssueIds rejects, when gatherProjectLensSignals runs, then it throws reason 'gather_failed'
Propagate unavailableReason through the membership snapshot service

expected_outputs: service test file passes including new propagation tests

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/server/services/pipeline-membership.ts: MembershipSnapshot (lines 63-69) gains lastErrorReason?: MembershipUnavailableReason; the refreshMembershipSnapshot catch (lines 86-95) records error instanceof PipelineMembershipUnavailableError ? error.reason : 'gather_failed' alongside the existing lastError string. ProjectPipelineMembershipResult (lines 44-48) gains unavailableReason?: MembershipUnavailableReason; readPipelineMembershipSnapshotsForProjects (103-118) populates it from the snapshot, and getPipelineMembershipSnapshotsForResourceDiscovery's failure result (line 157) passes it through as well. Do not change the .error field shape — routes/issues.ts:243-251 and resource-discovery read it unchanged. Tests: a getMembership rejecting with PipelineMembershipUnavailableError('forge_unavailable') → read result carries unavailableReason 'forge_unavailable'; a plain Error rejection → 'gather_failed'; a successful refresh clears lastErrorReason.

Return HTTP 200 with the typed unavailable body from the membership routes

'gather_failed', message: error message, projectKey}; no snapshot and no error → keep the 503 'Pipeline membership snapshot is loading' (NFR-2). Frontend membership probe parses the typed unavailable body
